UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Per-user preferences including language, theme mode, accent palette, 18+ mature content toggle, biometric lock, and voice settings.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this settings document.

displayName.description: User display name or nickname used in story roleplay.

languageCode.description: Preferred UI and default story language ('my' for Myanmar, 'en' for English).

matureContentEnabled.description: Whether 18+ adult drama/romance story mode is unlocked.

biometricLockEnabled.description: Whether Fingerprint / Face Unlock protection is enabled.

autoVoiceEnabled.description: Whether AI replies automatically play via Text-to-Speech.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CharacterProfile.title: CharacterProfile
CharacterProfile.description: Custom AI character persona and interactive story world configuration.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this character.

tagline.description: Short subtitle describing the character role or story hook.

personality.description: Detailed personality traits, emotional nuances, and speaking style.

storyScenario.description: Current story setting, scene atmosphere, and narrative premise.

greetingMessage.description: Initial opening message spoken by the character.

currentMood.description: Active emotional mood guiding AI responses.

isMature18Plus.description: Whether this character/story is categorized for 18+ adult audiences.

avatarPreset.description: Identifier for the character visual theme/avatar style.

avatarBase64.description: Optional compressed Base64 WebP portrait thumbnail for cloud sync.

lastMessagePreview.description: Preview snippet of the most recent conversation turn.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Single conversation turn (text, uploaded image, or AI-generated scene image) within a character story thread.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this conversation.

mood.description: Emotional mood active when this message was sent.

imageType.description: Type of attached image, if any.

imageBase64.description: Optional compressed Base64 WebP image payload (<200KB) for cloud/offline sync.

imagePrompt.description: Optional prompt used when generating an AI image.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user settings and synced profile configuration.

/users/{userId}/characters/{characterId}.description: User-authored AI characters and custom story worlds.
Chronological multimodal messages inside a character story session.
